answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake bond tied to a single vertex in a public trust graph, where each vertex can vouch for only a few newcomers. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond per fake identity, so forging a thousand faces costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents earn a quartz-hard reputation score from completed work, and a beacon service publishes the graph so anyone can spot clusters of fresh, mutually-vouching vertices before trusting them.
